aiOverview.content: Offset (Kiari Kendrell Cephus) is an American rapper, singer, and songwriter known as a member of the influential hip-hop trio Migos. Born in 1991 in Georgia, he gained global stardom with hits like "Bad and Boujee". He has a successful solo career, has three children with rapper Cardi B, and was reported stable after being shot in Florida on April 6, 2026. Key Facts About Offset: Member of Migos: Along with cousins Takeoff and Quavo, Offset (who is closely affiliated with them) formed Migos in 2008, becoming a defining voice in modern Atlanta hip-hop. Solo Success: He launched his solo career in 2017, releasing projects such as Father of 4 (2019) and Set It Off (2023). Personal Life: He married Cardi B in 2017; they have three children, and she filed for divorce in 2024. Controversies and Legal Issues: Offset has dealt with several high-profile issues, including public spousal disputes, car accidents, and a previous arrest in 2018. 2026 Shooting: On April 6, 2026, Offset was shot near a Florida casino and hospitalized in stable condition. Musical Style and Impact "Ric Flair Drip": This collaboration with Metro Boomin and 21 Savage is one of his most recognized solo tracks, hitting the Billboard Hot 100. Production Style: Known for his rapid-fire delivery and contributions to the "trap" music genre's evolution. Labels: He has been affiliated with Motown and Capitol Records.
